acceptanceCriteria: Owner decision recorded; if yes, a follow-up ticket amends TSA-V0-210 with tests.
body: Raised by the V1-1947 lane (PR #1211): TSA-V0-210 keeps profile-named compose.NAME and .env.NAME files unread, so a compose env_file naming the profile's own .env.NAME stays unread (Codex finding 4 fix). Owner decision needed on whether reading them is in scope; reading them would amend accepted TSA-V0-210.

completion.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-19: do not read profile-named compose.NAME / .env.NAME files; TSA-V0-210 stands; no follow-up.

title: Should the env contract read profile-named compose.NAME / .env.NAME files (TSA-V0-210 keeps them unread)?
